stem:
Meera keeps her steel lunch box on the dining table and it stays at rest.
Which statement about the forces acting on the lunch box is correct?

options.text: No force acts on the lunch box because it is not moving.
The lunch box has balanced forces acting on it, so it stays at rest.
The lunch box will stay at rest only if all forces on it are removed.
An object at rest always has an unbalanced force acting on it.

teacher.key_rationale: An object at rest does not imply that no force acts on it; the lunch box experiences weight downward and the normal reaction from the table upward, which balance each other, so the net force is zero and it stays at rest. Options A and C trap students who equate rest with absence of force, and D reverses the balance condition.
